shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library for normal vanilla log lines, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs with an offline snapshot, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a plain-language glossary), an in-game bug/fix report composer, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette (with nested breadcrumb paths), plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field; used by both the modern log search and the dev-actions search.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.** When on, `Patch_CheckOpenLogWindow` suppresses the log's auto-open while `Current.ProgramState == ProgramState.Entry` and consumes `EditWindow_Log.wantsToOpen`. Still auto-opens in-game; manual open always works.

### Benign "no concern" classification (NEW 2026-07-26)
Normal, no-fault vanilla log lines (version banner, "Initializing new game with mods:", "Command line arguments:", "Save data folder overridden to", "Loading game from file … with mods:") were being shown as unsolved errors ("Not in library"), and worse, the mod-list dumps lit up every listed mod as a "Likely source" because their packageIds appear in the text (`Module_MessageMentions.TryPackage`). Fixed with a **benign library**:
- `KnownIssueDef.benign` (bool). Curated entries live in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` (5 entries, text-only anchored regexes verified against decompiled Verse/RimWorld). Any mod can ship its own.
- `KnownIssueIndex.HasBenignMatch(ctx)` runs in `LogAnalysisCache.Compute` **before** the module loop, but only when `msg.type != Error` (a real error is never "no concern"). It sets `ctx.Benign`.
- While `ctx.Benign`, **`ErrorContext.Merge` no-ops all attribution** — the single choke point — so no module can implicate a mod for a benign line (kills the packageId-dump noise at the source and cascades to suppress dependent diagnoses like version-mismatch).
- `Module_KnownIssues` carries `def.benign` onto the `ErrorDiagnosis` (green strip) and, on a benign line, emits only benign diagnoses.
- Inspector when benign: banner badge = **"No concern"** (green) instead of "Not in library"; impact level forced to Info; "Likely source" replaced by `MDT_BenignNoSource` one-liner; report card hidden. `LogAnalysis.Benign => Context.Benign`; `ImpactResult.Benign`.
- Dev test: **"Log benign vanilla line (no-concern demo)"** logs an un-prefixed "Initializing new game with mods:" dump listing packageIds, to prove classification + attribution suppression.

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Pipeline: per module, `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses displayed sorted by `Score` desc. Modules: `Module_StackTrace`, `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, `Module_HarmonyPatches`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues` (~32-entry issue library + 5-entry benign library), `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_Glossary`.

**Index prewarm (startup, bg thread).** `Bootstrap` kicks `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` off-thread. The Harmony index is NOT prewarmed (built lazily on first analysis).

**Harmony patch-owner attribution (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`, order 26).** Reverse-maps `"Type.FullName:Method" → owner-id[]` from `Harmony.GetAllPatchedMethods()`+`GetPatchInfo(m).Owners`, built lazily. Diagnosis only when ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace. Self owner excluded.

**Proactive dependency & load-order scan (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, order 60).** Reads every active mod's `<modDependencies>` + `LoadBefore/After`/`ForceLoad*`, mirroring vanilla `ModsConfig.GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts`. Runs late so it sees all attribution.

**Plain-language glossary (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `DrawSection`, order 900).** Scans the error + diagnoses for jargon (Harmony, transpiler, def, cross-reference, xpath, patch operation, stack trace, null reference, TPS, FPS, load order, packageId, HugsLib, type-load) and draws a "Terms in this error" card (cap 6).

**Diagnosis source layering:** mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json` → community bug DB → shipped library → About.xml incompats. Shared `CommunityData.ParseIssues`/`Match`.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (PUBLIC, live, 14 curated engine-level signatures). **Offline snapshot:** same corpus ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` (~3.5 KB).

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less composer; destination hierarchy: culprit mod's GitHub → its Workshop page → community Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a → `[#xxxxxxxx]`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph. `DebugActions_Testing` adds category "Modern Dev Tools" (top) with test-log/exception actions incl. a "Log error with jargon (glossary demo)" and a "Log benign vanilla line (no-concern demo)". Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid; every mod call hardened (`DebugTree`). Palette-pin path `Category\<label>` (backslash-separated `DebugActionNode.Path`).
- **Esc:** steps up one level in a submenu, closes at the top level.
- **Hides the dev palette while open** (palette is `WindowLayer.Super`; `PreOpen` removes it with `suppressClosePref=true`, `PostClose` re-adds it if `DebugSettings.devPalette` still on).
- **Whole-tab search (`SearchResults`)** BFS (depth cap 6, cap 400), time-boxed (~300 ms + 20k node cap); auto-focus deferred one frame so the `/` hotkey can't leak into the box.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`. Resolves pinned nodes from `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette` via `Dialog_Debug.GetNode`. **Nested breadcrumb paths** (two-line rows for nested actions); variable row heights; `SetInitialSizeAndPosition` auto-fits.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) on focus changes, NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). Benign keys: `MDT_Benign` ("No concern"), `MDT_BenignNoSource`.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked; `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored.
